Both workers are running, and HyperFrames is now in AGENTS.md as the default for post media.

Worker 1, earshot slice 5:
- One repo: the public GitHub repo becomes the only working copy. The old private one moves to .archive.

- Early link: the Listen link appears immediately and the page fills in as the audio arrives.
- Your install: the Claude Code skill, user scope only, so your settings.json is untouched. Then "narrate this" in any session returns a Listen link.
- Delivery: a pull request on the public repo, merged once the tests pass.
- Update from Max: the chat shows two links, Listen (edited) and Listen original, and each one streams audio so it plays on click.

Worker 2, post-media:
- A skill plus a CLI you can run yourself: post-media new, post-media render, post-media stills.
- Formats: 1080x1350 for X and LinkedIn, 1080x1920 for reels, 1920x1080, plus still images.
- Inputs: a post.json with the hook, 2 to 4 beats, the end card and an optional voiceover. earshot memos can be the voiceover.
- Proof: it re-makes launch post A with the new template.
